# Quill

A complete, valid Ascribe project: the documentation set for Quill, a made-up docs-sync tool. Its centerpiece is the page from [SPEC Appendix B](../../SPEC.md#appendix-b-complete-example), `docs/install-agent.md`, which is byte for byte the page in the specification.

```
ascribe.toml                       the content model (SPEC Appendix B, plus image attributes)
docs/
  install-agent.md                 the Appendix B page
  quickstart.md                    has the `try-in-browser` id the page links to
  keys.md                          has the `rotate-keys` id the page links to
  playground.png                   an image beside quickstart.md
  _fragments/
    prerequisites.md               included by the page
    prerequisites.png              an image beside the fragment, used inside it
```

The project has no errors under any of its builds (`site`, `cloud`, and `self-managed-3.3`). The conformance suite has a copy as the project case `projects/quill`, and a test keeps the two identical (`tests/conformance/tests/quill_example.rs`).
# The content model for examples/quill: the model SPEC Appendix B assumes (see
# examples/content-models/quill.toml), plus image attributes.
spec = "0.1"

[project]
content-root = "docs"
output-dir = ".ascribe/build"

# Every page is a `page`. Appendix B's frontmatter has `title` and
# `description`; `available` is reserved and always accepted.
[types.page]
default = true

[types.page.frontmatter]
title = "string"
description = { type = "string?", role = "description" }

# `@variant {pm=npm}:` and friends.
[dimensions.pm]
label = "Package manager"
values = ["npm", "pnpm", "yarn"]
labels = { yarn = "Yarn" }

# `@variant {deployment=cloud}:` and `@available: cloud, self-managed preview 3.3`.
# `cloud` has no versions. `self-managed` keeps its own name as its label, which
# gives SPEC §9.4's example line: "Available: Quill Cloud (GA); self-managed
# (preview, 3.4+)".
[dimensions.deployment]
label = "Deployment"
values = ["cloud", "self-managed"]
versionless = ["cloud"]
labels = { cloud = "Quill Cloud" }

[phrases]
product = "Quill"
cloud = "Quill Cloud"
version = "3.4.1"
api = "https://api.quill.dev/v3/"

# Image attributes: `![alt](src){width=600}`.
[images.attributes]
width = "number?"
height = "number?"

[consumer]
profile = "astro"
site = "https://docs.quill.dev"

# The published site: every arm as a switcher, availability as badges.
[builds.site]
variants = "switch"
availability = "badge"

# Quill Cloud only: deployment groups reduce to their cloud arm, and content
# not available on cloud is removed. The `pm` group stays a full switcher.
[builds.cloud]
variants = { deployment = "cloud" }
availability = { filter = "cloud" }

# Self-managed 3.3: every arm kept, content not available on self-managed 3.3
# removed (such as the streaming-sync section, in preview from 3.4).
[builds."self-managed-3.3"]
variants = "switch"
availability = { filter = "self-managed 3.3" }

[editor]
build = "site"

The project now checks clean: 0 errors, 0 warnings, on the default check and on each of the `site`, `cloud` and `self-managed-3.3` builds.

The broken link was in `docs/install-agent.md:93`, which points to `keys.md#rotate-keys`, but the page holding that `rotate-keys` id was named `docs/api-keys.md`. I renamed the file to `docs/keys.md` rather than editing the link, because the README says `install-agent.md` must stay byte for byte the spec's page and lists the target as `keys.md`.

The rename also cleared the "orphan page" advice on that page. The change is staged as a `git mv` but not committed.
